How to get it :
- Crafting table (x6) : [[gv:billet_pb209|Lead-209 Billet]].
- Crafting table (x9) : [[gv:ingot_pb209|Lead-209 Ingot]].
- [[SILEX|Laser Isotope Separation Chamber (SILEX)]] : [[gv:nuclear_waste_short_schrabidium|Short-Lived Nuclear Waste]].

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_pb209|Lead-209 Billet]], [[gv:ingot_pb209|Lead-209 Ingot]], [[Bismuth|Bismuth Nugget]].
